events.title: Ambarella at the AI Infrastructure Summit in Santa Clara

facts.text: Explicit disclosure: N1-655 powered an autonomous mobile manipulator running SmolVLA, SLAM, navigation and pick-and-place workloads on a single chip.
Explicit disclosure: a Unitree humanoid demo performed intelligent vision, perception and voice-driven interaction with an AI-driven vision-to-action loop directly on-device.
Explicit disclosure: a warehouse demo combined Dify, Liquid AI models, live video and RAG on N1-655.
Explicit disclosure: Thinkware Harmony QXD1 Plus dashcam uses Ambarella CV25 Edge AI SoC.

Explicit disclosure: Ambarella introduced X7 as its first standalone AI accelerator and said it can add AI processing alongside existing host computers without necessarily replacing installed equipment.

Explicit disclosure: Ambarella announced an Ultralytics collaboration for YOLO on CVflow devices, expanded Developer Zone with remote live-silicon/agentic-AI development on Google Cloud Platform, and announced a ZEDEDA partnership for cloud-orchestrated physical-edge AI.
Explicit disclosure: Ambarella states more than 50 million AI processors/AI SoC units are already deployed.

events.title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows

facts.text: Explicit disclosure: PReFlow combines critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow.
Explicit disclosure: the objective is KL-regularized and induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior.
Explicit disclosure: the method uses simulation-free, closed-form adjoint matching targets and a single velocity-regression loss without a backward adjoint solve.
Explicit disclosure: evaluation covers 50 OGBench tasks; after online fine-tuning the abstract reports the highest aggregate score among compared methods, reaching 91% after 500K environment steps.
